candidates.title: Google puts Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a fast cheaper model, into Search for everyone
candidates.summary: Google rolled Gemini 4 Hydrogen into Search globally, calling it the biggest model upgrade to Search yet; it is 2.5x faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash and costs $1.50 per million input tokens.

articles.title: Google Search gets a major upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
Google's latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions
Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen brings a fast, cheaper model to everyone

facts.text: Today, Google Search is bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone with Gemini 4 Hydrogen. This is the biggest model upgrade to Search yet.
Hydrogen is now available globally in Google Search for all users
Google says Hydrogen completes tasks 2.5 times faster than Gemini 3.8 Flash, its previous fast model
even beating the more powerful Gemini 4 Argon on one broad intelligence benchmark, the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, at its default high thinking level
The model offers four thinking levels: low, medium, high (default), and a new, extra-high tier ("xhigh")
Gemini 4 Hydrogen is coming to all tiers of Google's AI Studio, the Gemini API, the Gemini App, and the paid AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in Google's Antigravity development platform.

For developers, it costs $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens. That is less than half the standard price of Google's flagship Gemini 4 Argon. Hydrogen can handle up to 1 million tokens of input at once.
Google also says Hydrogen makes up facts five times less often than 3.8 Flash.
Artificial Analysis puts its top setting one point behind Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5

candidates.title: Hack at Fireworks AI exposes Notion AI chat transcripts
candidates.summary: Attackers breached Fireworks AI's cloud provider and stole customer data; Notion says about 1% of its customers were affected, including Notion AI 'Insights' chat transcripts.

articles.title: Cyberattack on Fireworks AI allowed hackers to access Notion customers' chat transcripts

facts.text: Fireworks AI, a platform that developers use to access and use open AI models, said an attacker breached its cloud provider to gain access to a Fireworks development system
the cybercriminals took Fireworks' customers' billing information and some datasets
Fireworks touts tens of thousands of customers worldwide using its platform, including legal tech company Harvey and AI company Cursor.
Notion, which said in a disclosure that the breach affected around 1% of its own customers.
On November 3, Notion said it disconnected its systems from Fireworks, deleted the data stored in its systems, and stopped all connectivity between the two.
the hackers took chat transcripts of its Notion AI customers who used the "Insights" feature
their goals are focused on selling tokens from breaching access to large language models
This is the second breach affecting Fireworks in as many months, following a security incident in October.

candidates.title: United Airlines blocks personal AI agents from booking flights
candidates.first_published_note: Earliest seen: AI타임스 Korean rewrite 15:11 UTC citing reports; Reuters headline in feeds.json; TechCrunch 17:17 UTC. Lead with TechCrunch.
candidates.summary: United says it will restrict unauthorized third-party AI agents from booking and managing reservations, citing credential leaks, unintended purchases and federal rules requiring a human check-in.

articles.title: United Airlines blocks AI agents from booking flights, citing cybersecurity risks

facts.text: United Airlines said it will restrict access to AI agents seeking to book flights and manage reservations on their users' behalf

"sharing account credentials with personal, third-party, AI assistants can expose sensitive information, and actions taken by these tools may result in unintended purchases, account changes, or use of MileagePlus miles."
requiring that a human completes flight check-ins to acknowledge that their bags do not contain banned substances

"United is taking steps to restrict access — directly within our digital platforms and indirectly via travel agencies and aggregators — to prohibit use by unauthorized, third-party personal AI agents or assistants"
The airline's move follows a warning from banks, including Bank of America, which last week urged customers not to share their passwords with their AI assistants.
